name: Fundacio FC Barcelona
verdict: Owned by the Fundació FC Barcelona (Barça Foundation), created in 1994 and funded mainly by the Club, players and external financiers. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: The back-of-shirt placement is the club's own charitable foundation logo (replacing UNHCR/ACNUR), a self-promotional charitable placement like Sevilla's Fundacion 1890; not a state or fund sponsor.
